notes.title: Conga Combat Released on Steam! (Plus a note to early adopters)
notes.content:
Hi all!

Well, here we go... After being Greenlit what seems like a lifetime ago, Conga Combat is finally on Steam, complete with achievements and online leaderboards :)

We've given it our best shot in the testing lab, but of course the 'real' test starts now - so if you have any issues with the game please contact us over at www.rgcd.co.uk.

An important note to previous owners of the game; we've upgraded the protection on the scoreboards, and as a result of this you will need to reset your game progress on the Steam version if you have played it on your PC before.

To do this, select 'options' from the menu, then 'reset game'.

You will lose all locally unlocked achievements, scores and stats, but you'll be able to upload scores and achievements as you unlock them again.

Beta testers: the same applies to you - you will need to reset the game. In addition, the cloud sync is one-way, so after this reset you will not upload any new scores or achievements until you match your previous progress online. Sorry about that(!)

James & Jamie @ RGCD.DEV
